features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio; >>1 in separating shear layers and APG where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs turbulent turnover; >0 in adverse-pressure-gradient deceleration/separation, <0 in favorable acceleration.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Turbulent length over wall distance; separates near-wall log-layer from free-shear wake/separation where SST needs different correction.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L: f_curv (1/T)/(1/T), f_accel [L/T2]/([1/T][L/T]), f_apgw [L3/T3]/[L3/T3]. f_curv denominator W+S+omega>0 so 100% finite; f_accel singular only where k=0 at wall, f_apgw singular only where k=0 or Umag=0 at wall/stagnation, both <1% points like existing f_wall/f_apg. None constant; orderings distinct from I1/I2 and f_noneq Pk/eps. Dropped f_apg (unused, gain 0.0) and f_wall (gain -0.0005, harmful on heldout); wall sensitivity retained via f_apgw with d. Signed features preserve APG/FPG and strain/rotation ordering through median normalization.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation-vs-strain imbalance; negative in strain-dominated stagnation/acceleration, ~0 in parallel shear, positive in rotation-dominated curvature and separation bubbles on bumps.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration versus turbulent frequency times velocity scale; large in converging-throat acceleration and APG deceleration where SST lags non-equilibrium.

features.name: f_apgw
features.rationale: Signed pressure work along streamline weighted by wall distance vs mean kinetic energy; >0 in near-wall APG separation/reattachment, <0 in favorable acceleration.

proposal.risk_audit: All three formulas unit-checked invariant under U->2U, L->3L; denominators >0 at cell centers (omega>0, k+Umag^2>0 interior) so finite on >99% with only exact-wall 0/0 risk; bounded in [0,1] or (-1,1) so no overflow, ordering distinct from f_noneq/I1/I2 (wall-vs-shear, momentum-deficit, signed APG/FPG); dropping f_curv/f_accel/f_apgw with 0 gain/0 terms to free search and avoid dilution, replaced by more robust bounded versions targeting worst heldout converging_diverging_channel.

features.name: f_wake
features.rationale: Turbulent length over wall distance; ~0 attached near-wall, ->1 in detached shear layer above bump/channel bubble where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_sep
features.rationale: Turbulence intensity; ~1 in low-speed recirculation/reattachment, ~0 in high-speed throat/freestream, marking separation momentum deficit.

features.name: f_apg2
features.rationale: Bounded signed pressure-work vs dissipation; >0 APG deceleration/separation, <0 FPG throat acceleration, targeting converging-diverging error.

features: DUDt_mag * d / (Umag * Umag + k + DUDt_mag * d)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 are dimensionless (vel x2/len x3 invariant); f_curv denom has omega>0 so 100% finite, f_acc/f_lim 0/0 only at exact wall (k=Umag=nut=DUDt=0, <1% points); ordering only matters due to median rescaling; f_curv complements I1/I2 with unscaled kinematics, f_acc targets worst-case converging-diverging acceleration, f_lim targets SST limiter active zones distinct from Pk/eps and k/(k+Umag^2); drop f_wake/f_apg2 with zero gain/terms to free slots.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Strain-dominated vs rotation-dominated marker for curvature and throat vs bubble where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_acc
features.formula: DUDt_mag * d / (Umag * Umag + k + DUDt_mag * d)
features.rationale: Bounded material acceleration vs kinetic energy marking FPG throat acceleration and APG separation in worst heldout channel.

features.name: f_lim
features.rationale: SST Bradshaw limiter sensor; ~0.5 where nut=k/omega, ->1 where limiter cuts nut in APG/high-strain needing anisotropy fix.

features: DUDt_mag * d / (Umag * Umag + k + DUDt_mag * d)
gradp_mag * d / (gradp_mag * d + k + Umag * Umag)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 proposed ratios verified dimensionless under velocity*2/length*3 scaling (L2/T3 over L2/T3; L2/T2 over L2/T2; L/T over L/T); denominators >0 in interior (eps>0 or k>0 or Umag>0) so finite on >>99% (only exact wall face 0/0 possible, not cell centers); bounded/order-varying, not constant; complementary to retained f_noneq (magnitude non-eq) and f_acc (acceleration magnitude) by adding APG sign, pressure-force magnitude, and wall-vs-free-shear location; no duplication of I1/I2 strain-rotation invariants that made f_curv useless.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG vs FPG alignment (cos U-gradp); >0 adverse decelerating separation, <0 favorable throat acceleration where SST fails.

features.name: f_pgrad
features.formula: gradp_mag * d / (gradp_mag * d + k + Umag * Umag)
features.rationale: Pressure force vs inertia/TKE; ~1 in APG separation bubble/reattachment, ~0 in high-speed throat/freestream.

features.name: f_wallshear
features.rationale: Wall-proximity shear vs convection/turbulence; high near-wall/throat, low in detached free shear marking SST error zone.
